name: MainOne / Google route leak
notes: AS37282 (MainOne, Nigeria) accepted Google's prefixes from a peer and propagated them upstream to AS4809 (China Telecom), which propagated to AS20485 (Transtelecom Russia), which reached tier-1 AS2914 (NTT) -- a textbook Type-1 leak per RFC 7908. onset_iso is the first AS37282 transit observation at RRC00 in the data fetched on 2026-05-09 (peer 15562, path '15562 2914 20485 4809 37282 15169', prefix 185.25.28.0/23, 21:12:16Z), which matches the BGPmon-reported onset (21:12 UTC) to the second. 203 distinct Google prefixes were observed transiting AS37282 in the 90-minute window. expected_detectors is intentionally empty: no detector currently shipped catches this case -- origin is the correct AS15169 throughout, so MOAS, sub-prefix, RPKI-invalid, and withdraw-spike all silent. Building a route-leak detector (AS-relationships from CAIDA serial-2, valley-free path checking per RFC 7908) is the next concrete extension; this incident is the test case it should catch.
